testcase.name: there are always enough copies of a round to fill the column
the delay is minutes, with a floor and a ceiling
the channel's screensaver answers to both switches, the clock's to the master one alone
the scene clock moves only when the kind of screen changes
the ring fills up to the current second
each screensaver waits its own idle period
only the bare video and its passthrough overlays leave the picture as the screen
a paused station is a paused stream, not now playing
a paused film is a still screen
the home screen is a still screen, with a channel playing behind its banner
nothing playing, or a failed stream, is the clock alone
a screen that turned still after the last key press is left alone for the idle period
the headlines are still where they should be after a night
a channel playing under a guide or a menu is a still screen
the drift does not repeat after one cycle
a station playing on its own screen is a still screen
a station playing behind the screensaver is now playing
the programme's bar runs from its start to its end and no further
a live channel under a menu, paused, failed or with no picture is still
a channel that fails after a long watch is given the clock's full wait
a paused channel names itself and its programme
the ambient hue never leaves its swing
a film playing full screen is left alone
a failed stream is a still screen
the shift stays in its box and moves on every step
the drift reaches the edges of its travel on both axes
today's headline shows the clock, an older one the date as well
the drift stays inside the box it is given
the headlines move down continuously and wrap without a jump
a key press on a still screen restarts the countdown
the shift does not return to where it was
nothing playing is a still screen
the ambient hue swings around the station's own colour and stays on the wheel
a stall does not restart the channel's hour
the guard is off when the setting is off, in picture-in-picture, and over a film being watched
a live channel playing full screen is watched, and goes to the channel's screensaver
